blueprint.summary: Cincinnati Bengals hold $7.62M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($7.62M effective) and +$48.85M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Duke Tobin and the Bengals front office hold $7.62M in gross 2026 cap space ($7.62M effective), while 2027 currently projects at +$48.85M under an estimated $327M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($4M–$6M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins, Ja'Marr Chase, Orlando Brown Jr..

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($4M–$6M Target vs. +$48.85M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Cincinnati's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.
